title: Reference-ET Potential-Transpiration Root-Uptake Input Ownership Binding
goal: Resolve potential_transpiration ownership without duplicating ET physics: the canonically admitted F-MR23 reference-ET demand result is the authoritative runtime ptra source; a small stateless seam copies only that value into the existing canonical crop_root_uptake_input_t before the already admitted F-MR12 adapter consumes it.

ownership_decision.crop_root_uptake_input_ptra_role: transport field only after this binding, not an independent producer
ownership_decision.historical_F_WOF18_role: frozen formula-equivalence evidence only; not runtime authority and not imported into canonical source
ownership_decision.preexisting_base_input_ptra: ignored as a source and overwritten after validating the non-ptra crop/root geometry view

contract.input_ET_result: reference_et_demand_result_t from a successful F-MR23 evaluation
contract.input_ET_diagnostics: fmr_reference_et_binding_diagnostics_t with status OK and result_produced=true
contract.input_root_object: existing crop_root_uptake_input_t carrying crop emergence and root geometry; its preexisting ptra is non-authoritative
contract.active_nodes: explicit positive integer used by the existing crop-root contract
contract.output: canonical crop_root_uptake_input_t with all non-ptra fields preserved and ptra replaced by the authoritative F-MR23 result
contract.transaction_semantics: purely derived stateless composition; no committed state mutation
contract.mass_semantics: ptra remains a potential demand rate; no withdrawal, integration or ledger booking occurs

fail_closed_rules: reject unsuccessful or non-produced F-MR23 ET result
validate crop/root geometry after neutralizing the non-authoritative incoming ptra
reject a final assembled root-input object that violates the existing canonical contract
produce a default empty output on rejection
qualification_requirements: authoritative ptra is copied exactly from F-MR23 output
incoming ptra cannot influence output ptra, including stale, negative, nonfinite and conflicting finite values
crop_emerged, rooted_nodes and cumulative_root_fraction are preserved exactly on accepted inputs
binding source contains no ET formula or ET forcing/canopy-factor recomputation
no persistent state, mass ledger, root-water withdrawal, crop advancement, file I/O or hydraulic internals

architecture_invariants.single_kernel: preserved; composition uses existing shared process/runtime contracts
architecture_invariants.explicit_data_separation: ET result is consumed as a result object; root geometry stays in its existing contract
architecture_invariants.generic_time: inherits the qualified F-MR23 interval/forcing contract without adding calendar assumptions
architecture_invariants.mass_conservation: no mass is booked or removed
architecture_invariants.multiswap: constant-size stateless operation per column and no heavyweight per-column solver object
architecture_invariants.no_silent_dependencies: authority and status preconditions are explicit
